data.summary: CI's build probe ran 'python -c' from the checkout root, so it imported the SOURCE ddflow, not the installed wheel: a wheel with companions.toml stripped passed (exit 0). Fixed in 7536d99 (scripts/ci/build-probe.sh probes from a scratch dir and refuses if ddflow is not from site-packages; the stripped wheel now exits 1). Open until a pytest regression test pins it.

data.text: I have a problem - github publish and workflows produce errors. Can you check and correct them: [screenshots + log of CI run 36694543037: 'ruff format --check' failing on ddflow/api/quota.py in tests (3.11), tests (3.13) and quality; scenarios mcp-orchestration and full-lifecycle failing: cannot complete P1 — gate(s) never run and never skipped: docs]

can you make sure this ddflow project has a pre-commit rules, that check before we push to github that such issues will be corrected and the github workflows will pass?
Also I see github is complaining that node 20.x will be deprecated? Where do we use those in github workflow, and can we upgrade them?

data.how: The pre-push hook (.pre-commit-config.yaml, 'pre-commit install') now runs the scenarios whenever ddflow/, demos/ or tests/ changed; do not SKIP=scenarios on a push that touches gates, pipelines or complete.
data.rule: When a default gate, pipeline or completion rule changes, run 'pytest tests/test_scenarios.py -m slow' before merging: the unit_tests gate runs addopts' 'not slow', so the scenarios that drive a phase to completion never see the change, and CI is the first place they run.
data.title: A change to the default pipelines must run the slow scenarios before it lands
data.why: 8aa8170 added the phase 'docs' gate; every local gate passed, and main went red in CI because two scenarios closed P1 without it (bug B6d601e6ba0).

data.text: rubber_duck (the LAN critic, deepseek) recorded failed with 2 HIGH findings; both REFUTED by probe: (1) 'setup-uv@v10.2.0 does not exist' -- the tag list shows v10.2.0 as latest and raw action.yml at v10.2.0 is HTTP 200, node24; setup-uv publishes exact tags only since v8. (2) 'new-branch push passes the null sha as PRE_COMMIT_FROM_REF' -- pre-commit's hook_impl._pre_push_ns never exports Z40 (it uses the parent of the first unpushed commit); a real new-branch push to a scratch bare remote passed clean and blocked a leak. Probing (2) found an adjacent REAL gap: with no range exported (root-commit push) the fallback origin/main..HEAD named a missing ref and gitleaks scanned 0 commits, exit 0. Fixed in 02381a0 (scripts/ci/gitleaks-pushed.sh); a leaking root push now fails.

critic (the LAN critic, deepseek) recorded failed with 4 findings. ACCEPTED (1): build probe ran python -m ddflow, not the console script -- probed with a misspelled entry point: old exit 0, new exit 1; fixed. REFUTED (3): setup-uv@v10.2.0 exists (action.yml HTTP 200); golang hook does not 'go install ./...' in this repo -- for repo: local pre-commit builds a scratch repo from resources/empty_template_go.mod + main.go, and the hook installed and ran here; unfetched PRE_COMMIT_FROM_REF on force-push -- hook_impl._pre_push_ns only exports remote_sha when _rev_exists(remote_sha), else the parent of the first unpushed commit.
